title: Unit Event — What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child — Episode5 Hearts & Lost Children

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child
meta.Event Outline: With university practice exams looming, Mafuyu continues to study to meet her mother's expectations. Meanwhile, Mizuki suggests a trip to an amusement park for N25.

rows.Line: The day of the practice exam

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, Mom, I'm off to take the practice exam...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Good luck, Mafuyu.
You won't be home much later than usual, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I have to see how I did for each question before I can come home, so I may run a little late. I'll let you know when I start heading back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Understood. I'll be wishing you the best, so please get there safe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The exam's taking place... I think over there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's not actually that far from the station, but it's taking me so long to get there.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I have to get an A...
Mom's counting on me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why...? I just want her to be happy...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to seeing some good results.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you wouldn't have come here if some part of you thought she wasn't right, don't you think...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Are you at the testing center now?
Good luck with the practice exam.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <I'll be looking forward to hearing good news.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This is awful... My insides feel like they're getting all twisted up... I'm having trouble breathing...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I have to get there soon...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I don't take this exam, she'll...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you truly wish to do something, Mafuyu, you're free to do it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heya! Mafuyu, you about to take that practice exam? The rest of us just met up at PXL!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know you said you won't be able to make it, but you're welcome to join us if you finish scoring yourself and stuff early!>

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Please enjoy your visit to Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I go back now, I can still make it in time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The last time you visited SEKAI, you looked like you were in pain.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And Len wanted to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? Miku? Len...?
I didn't realize you two were also here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, Mafuyu, what about your practice exam? Was there a last-minute schedule change or something?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If that's the case, you should've let us know that you were coming. Oh, who am I kidding...? At least we ran into you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hang on. Are you skipping it?
No, that's not something you'd do either...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we go for a little walk...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We don't really know what's going on and you don't have to tell us if you don't feel up to it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But since we're here...
I know it might be hard to get in the mood to have fun, so let's at least try to enjoy the scenery and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And you're free to leave whenever you like. We won't stop you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
Let's go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is your guys' first time at PXL too, right, Miku? Wanna check it out with us?
